name: GTA Vice City
description: Step into the neon-lit streets of Vice City and experience the thrill of the 1980s! 🌴🚗 Explore a vast open world filled with luxury cars, motorcycles, exciting missions, and unforgettable adventures. Immerse yourself in a captivating crime story, discover hidden locations, and experience the freedom to explore a city full of life, action, and surprises. From the bustling streets to the beautiful oceanfront, every corner offers a new adventure. Your journey to becoming a legend in Vice City starts here! 🎮🔥

about.title: About this game
about.description: Explore Vice City, drive vehicles, discover the city, and experience an action-packed adventure.
